documents.text: EPC Contract for Project ALPHA. GC 4.12: notice of differing site conditions within 28 days. GC 8.4: notice of delay events within 28 days. GC 13.1: variation notices within 14 days (as amended by Amendment 3).
We write to report differing site conditions encountered at Area 7 during piling. Rock elevations differ materially from the geotechnical baseline report.
Late delivery of long-lead compressors will cause a delay to the critical path of approximately three weeks, per the attached fragnet.
Please treat this letter as confirmation of the site instruction to add a third pipe rack in Area 12. We consider this a variation order under the contract.
Weekly progress meeting. Contractor mentioned possible resequencing of piping in Area 9; no schedule impact identified yet. To be reviewed next week.
Routine daily report. Scaffolding crew slightly behind schedule this morning due to permit queue; recovered by end of shift. No impact.
Progress has stalled on the compressor foundations for eleven days awaiting revised IFC drawings. We reserve our rights under the contract.
Correspondence from an unrelated project. We report differing site conditions at the jetty.
